# GlobalHorizontalIrradianceFromClearsky（seed 4）

## 背景

This series contains Global Horizontal Irradiance for a location in Magdalena, Colombia.
The Global Horizontal Irradiance is the total amount of sun energy (in Watts per squared meter) arriving on a horizontal surface.
